children: Overview
Canada quick-service burger chain's fiscal Q3 revenue grew 11% yr/yr
Net income for fiscal Q3 rose yr/yr, driven by higher revenue and lower finance expense
Company opened 9 new A&W restaurants and 1 new Pret shop in Q3
Outlook
Company maintains 2026 Adjusted EBITDA outlook at C$103 mln to C$105 mln
A&W expects 2026 System Sales Growth of 2.5%-5.0% and Same Store Sales Growth of 0.5%-3.0%
Company plans to end 2026 with 1,112 to 1,120 A&W restaurants in Canada
Result Drivers
BURGER PROMOTION - Co said smash-style burger promotion drove 1.8% same store sales growth in Q3
NEW RESTAURANTS - Higher equipment and turnkey revenue reflected opening of six additional A&W restaurants and one Pret shop in Q3
SERVICE FEE MIGRATION - Co said increase in service fee revenue was due to migration of A&W restaurants to higher service fee rate
